title: Olive leaf extract as a natural antioxidant and antimicrobial additive in biodegradable PLA film and its potential utilization in active packaging
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41978-41994
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04293C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Siwar Soltani, Sawssen Hajji, Noureddine Allouche, Sami Boufi
This study investigates a biodegradable PLA film plasticised and infused with olive leaf extract (OLE) to provide antimicrobial and antioxidant properties for active packaging of fruits and delicate vegetables.
